left.title: Donald Trump’s Communications Director Resigns
left.body: Mike Dubke served in the White House for nearly three months before tendering his resignation.
left.roundup: Veteran GOP Strategist Mike Dubke resigned as WH Communications Director.

center.title: Mike Dubke Quits as White House Communications Director
center.body: Departure comes as President Trump seeks reset amid probes
center.roundup: Veteran GOP Strategist Mike Dubke resigned as WH Communications Director.

right.title: Mike Dubke Resigns as White House Communications Director
right.body: The seasoned Republican operative was one of the few staffers respected by establishment Republicans in Washington, D.C., but was ultimately unwilling to continue to try to shape a daily narrative for the Trump White House.
right.roundup: Veteran GOP Strategist Mike Dubke resigned as WH Communications Director.
